decision_conditions: The operations come within the provisions of Schedule 2, Part 1, Class E of the Town and Country Planning (General Permitted Development) (England) Order 2015, thereby not requiring planning permission.

Please note that this certificate is granted for the outbuilding to be used for office & gym that would be incidental to main dwelling and as described on the submitted plans. It must only be used for purposes incidental to the enjoyment of 57 The Mount, Romford and not for any trade or business including meetings nor as living accommodation. Should business including meeting or living accommodation use be intended, an application for full planning permission must be applied for and permission granted before such use could occur. The use of outbuildings as living accommodation is not typically deemed acceptable therefore it is important the outbuilding is only used for the purposes as listed above.

The applicant should note that the proposed floor and roof plan indicates that there will be 4 roof lights on top of the flat roof. The elevations do not show any projection above the flat roof, should the roof lights project above the flat roof then a planning application would be required as the overall height would be more than 2.5m.

This certificate provides confirmation that the development is lawful.  You should also check whether the development requires separate Building Regulation consent. Information is available on the Building Control webpages via http://www.havering.gov.uk/Pages/Category/Building-control.aspx?l1=200252 and the team is available between 9am and 10am Monday to Friday via 01708 432700.
description: Certificate of Lawfulness for proposed erection of rear outbuilding to be used as an office & gym
